desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on Iranian regional escalation (drones on Bahrain, proxy activity in Iraq) and Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian energy infrastructure. The single most important thread is Bahrain’s strong condemnation of Iranian drone attacks and explicit invocation of self-defence rights.

## MAIN THREADS

### Iranian drone attacks on Bahrain
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2122027523303145921) reports Bahrain’s Foreign Ministry statement condemning “in the strongest terms” recent Iranian drone attacks, including one destroyed today and two intercepted on Friday; Bahrain reserves Article 51 self-defence rights in coordination with GCC allies and calls on the UNSC to act.
- No other accounts in the window contradict or add detail.

### Iraqi crackdown on oil smuggling at Jurf al-Sakhar
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2122021654289064140) and follow-up posts note three strong explosions in the IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah stronghold after the PM confirmed oil smuggling, sacked nine officials including the PMF Babil commander, and referred suspects to the judiciary.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2122022030518223099) shares reported images from the site.

### Ukrainian strike on Ust-Luga port
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2122021905834373138) posts satellite imagery showing at least five tanks burned out after the 11 November DF strike on the Russian port facility.

### Israeli election-related allegations
- [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2122034518437867752) and [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2122029122948157755) highlight an Uvda investigation claiming Netanyahu’s office planted intelligence against Arab citizens in police databases ahead of elections, with a senior law-enforcement source warning future elections cannot be guaranteed fair.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2122036065855062471) – Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi landing in Islamabad on EP-IGF (unconfirmed).  
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2122030411186319634) – Captured Wagner veteran claims he never killed any Ukrainian soldiers (unconfirmed).  
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2122021654289064140) – Explosions in Jurf al-Sakhar linked to the smuggling probe (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for Bahraini or GCC follow-on military moves and any Iranian response; further Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy export hubs; and any escalation or arrests inside Iraq’s PMF network.
